name: Lotusden Halfling
description:
Lotusden Halfling
Long tied to the natural heart of the Lotusden Greenwood, these halflings have adapted to live synergistically with the chaotic laws of the wilds.

features.name: Age
features.description: A halfling reaches adulthood at the age of 20 and generally lives into the middle of his or her second century.

features.name: Size
features.description: Halflings average about 3 feet tall and weigh about 40 pounds. Your size is Small.

features.name: Speed
features.description: Your base walking speed is 25 feet.

features.name: Lucky
features.description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

features.name: Brave
features.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

features.name: Halfling Nimbleness
features.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

features.name: Child of the Wood
features.description: You know the druidcraft cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the entangle spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the spike growth spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Casting these spells with this trait doesn't require material components. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

features.name: Timberwalk
features.description: Ability checks made to track you have disadvantage, and you can move across difficult terrain made of nonmagical plants and undergrowth without expending extra movement.
